# Golden Hour – Slots Casino

> Golden Hour is a free-to-play social casino game for Android by Vglobal Co., Ltd., with 45+ unique 3D slot machines. It is for entertainment only and intended for adults aged 18 and over: there is no real-money gambling, you can't win cash or real-world prizes, and virtual chips have no cash value.

- Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=site.vglobal.android.casinog
- Optional in-app purchases are available.
- Support: vglobalcs24@gmail.com

## Features

- [45+ unique 3D slots](https://sscgl.vglobal.site/#slots): pirates, pharaohs, cowboys, robots, fast food and more, each with its own symbols, animations and bonus features, spread over ten lobby floors.
- [Lucky Time and progressive jackpots](https://sscgl.vglobal.site/#lucky-time): turn on Lucky Time in any lobby slot for a limited-time boost that brings bonus games and free spins more often; every slot also carries progressive jackpots that keep growing until someone hits them.
- [Ten lobby floors](https://sscgl.vglobal.site/#floors): each floor opens when your virtual chip balance reaches its mark, from 5M for the 2nd floor to 10B for the 10th, and brings new slot machines with bigger bets.
- [Daily Jackpot](https://sscgl.vglobal.site/#daily-jackpot): one free spin a day on a separate jackpot machine with GRAND, MAJOR, MINOR and MINI prizes.
- [Collect Bonus](https://sscgl.vglobal.site/#bonus): tap COLLECT BONUS in the lobby every 2 hours for free chips.
- [Rankings and social play](https://sscgl.vglobal.site/#social): rankings, gifts and messages with friends; finishing first earns Peerage titles that raise the Daily Jackpot bonus.
